title: Museum of Money Dallas Admission
requirements: Infants and small children can ride in a pram or stroller
All areas and surfaces are wheelchair accessible
Suitable for all physical fitness levels
cancellation: For a full refund, cancel at least 24 hours before the scheduled departure time.
blurb:
Step into MoMoney, one of Dallas' newest and most exciting attractions - an interactive Museum of Money unlike anything you've experienced before. This is hands-on, action-packed, and filled with larger-than-life exhibits, epic photo moments, and experiences that are just plain fun.

Crack a laser vault heist, bathe in cash, design your own currency, spot counterfeit bills, and so much more - and hey, you might even learn a thing or two about money along the way.

Perfect for a date night, family outing, or group visit - MoMoney is the kind of experience everyone walks away talking about. Located in the heart of downtown Dallas at 501 Elm Street, just steps from the iconic Dealey Plaza, it's the perfect addition to any Dallas itinerary whether you're a first-time visitor or a local looking for something truly different.

A visit worth every penny.
